source.title: Guidance for the Standard Audit File - Tax, Version 2.0, Appendix B: Schema
source.extraction: Text extracted mechanically from the PDF (133 pages). Occurrence and type per element as printed in the appendix. The archived copy is to be compared with the current OECD download

note: Flat list of the 423 element definitions of the schema appendix. Paths starting with AuditFile are in the document tree, paths starting with a type name (for example AddressStructure) are the members of a complex type that several elements use. min is the minimum occurrence inside the parent, so a mandatory element below an optional parent is mandatory only when the parent is present.
